name: art_leading_close_alone
_comment: S-4 at the bare case: a path that is nothing but Z. A ClosePath before any point has been established is a NO-OP (JYH, fleet council 2026-07-27: the artist never means a close-before-anything), so the art flattener emits nothing. NOT discriminating on its own -- the pre-fix code also returned [] here, for the wrong reason (it BAILED OUT rather than skipping). It is here as the boundary that stops a fix from emitting the uninitialised subpath start (0,0).

name: art_leading_close_then_lineto
_comment: The probe that first exposed the shared defect. A leading Z contributes nothing, so the L is the only point. DISCRIMINATES: the pre-fix close arm returned the empty accumulator immediately, so the whole path flattened to [] and art / pattern-along-path / bristle brush drew nothing at all.

name: art_leading_close_then_first_subpath
_comment: The exact vector measured in both ports: d = [Z, M(3,2), L(13,2)] returned [] with the leading Z and [[3,2],[13,2]] without it -- a path the artist can draw, silently flattening to nothing under a brush. DISCRIMINATES.

name: art_two_leading_closes_then_first_subpath
_comment: A no-op is a no-op however many times it repeats: two leading closes still leave the first real subpath intact. DISCRIMINATES against a fix that skips only the FIRST leading close (e.g. one guarded by a 'first command' flag rather than by the empty accumulator).

name: art_leading_close_then_closed_subpath
_comment: A leading Z in front of a subpath that closes NORMALLY. The leading close is a no-op; the trailing close is a real close and returns to the MoveTo (4,1), then ends the first subpath. The MoveTo is deliberately off the origin so a phantom point would differ by value as well as by count. DISCRIMINATES: pre-fix, [].

name: art_leading_close_then_cubic
_comment: The leading-close guard must not disturb the CURVE SAMPLER downstream of it: a leading Z, a MoveTo and one cubic yield the MoveTo plus the flattener's 16 uniform samples, values pinned. This is the geometry-VALUE vector for the family -- a leading-close battery that only counted points would be blind to a sampler that had drifted. The art flattener uses 16 steps for a cubic and 12 for a quad, NOT the shared FLATTEN_STEPS of the hit-test flattener, which is why this family cannot be folded into `flatten`. DISCRIMINATES: pre-fix, [].

name: art_close_terminates_the_first_subpath
_comment: SCOPE BOUNDARY, pinned against the OVER-fix. A close that is not leading still closes and still ENDS the first subpath: art along a path rides the first subpath only. The second subpath is not appended. This vector does not fail under the pre-fix code -- it is pinned against a WRONG fix (turning the close arm into an unconditional continue, which would append (23,2),(33,2) and silently change what 'the first subpath' means).

name: art_moveto_then_immediate_close
_comment: SCOPE BOUNDARY, and the reason the guard is 'the accumulator is empty' and NOT 'the current point equals the subpath start'. A MoveTo followed immediately by Z is a degenerate ZERO-LENGTH subpath: cx == sx and cy == sy exactly as at a leading close, but a point HAS been established, so the close is real -- it emits no duplicate vertex and ends the subpath, leaving the single MoveTo point. A guard written on the coordinates would wrongly treat this as leading and run on into whatever follows.

name: art_second_moveto_ends_the_first_subpath
_comment: SCOPE BOUNDARY: the OTHER terminator. A second MoveTo after a real segment ends the first subpath, with no close involved at all. Pinned so the leading-close guard cannot be mistaken for a licence to keep walking.
